newsitem.title: THAILAND: Amnuay backs government guarantee of private debt notes.
newsitem.headline: Amnuay backs government guarantee of private debt notes.

text.p: Thai Finance Minister Amnuay Viravan said on Wednesday that the Bank of Thailand is prepared to avail or guarantee repayment of promissory notes issued by Thai finance firms currently facing public runs on their deposits.

Amnuay told reporters that deposit runs at finance firms this week were not as heavy as reported in the media, nor did they amount to a high percentage of overall outstanding public deposits mobilised by the sector.
The minister declined to confirm reports that about 9.4 billion baht of mostly unmatured deposits were withdrawn from finance companies in the past two days.
